title: Hardcore Forever World
description: A modpack for a mostly vanilla experience in hardcore. Tweaked to be more minecrafty!
body:
# Visual Overhaul

Push your Hardcore world to its limits with a carefully crafted visual overhaul designed for long-term survival. This pack refines Minecraft’s atmosphere without breaking its vanilla identity-enhancing immersion while keeping clarity and performance in check when it matters most.

At its core is a custom-tuned BSL Shader configuration, balanced to deliver deeper lighting, richer colors, and more dynamic environments without interfering with gameplay visibility or mod compatibility (including Particular & Wakes). Paired with a curated selection of Vanilla Tweaks Resource and Data Packs, every element is designed to feel cohesive, natural, and survival-ready without changing the core gameplay mechanics in a way that feels "cheaty".

Whether you're navigating dark caves, watching the sun set on day 1000, or fighting to stay alive in your forever world, these settings ensure your experience looks as good as it feels.

## Features

- Custom BSL Shader setup optimized for Hardcore survival clarity and immersion
- Handpicked Vanilla Tweaks Resource & Data Packs for a cohesive experience
- Enhanced lighting, atmosphere, and environmental effects
- Balanced visuals that preserve the vanilla feel while elevating the world
- Simple installation to instantly replicate the full visual setup

Transform your Hardcore world into a visually rich, immersive experience-built to last as long as you do.

## BSL Shader Customization
Open Minecraft, go to your BSL Shader settings, and use the Import option to load the included configuration file in `datapacks\BSL_v10.1.1.zip.txt`. Once applied, the shader will automatically update to the customized configuration.

## Vanilla Tweaks

### Visuals (Resource Packs)
- *GUI*
  - Clearer Wither Hearts
  - Colored Ping Indicator
- *3D*
  - 3D Bookshelves, 3D Chiseled Bookshelves
  - 3D Pointed Dripstone
  - 3D Chains, 3D Iron & Copper Bars
  - 3D Rails, 3D Ladders
  - 3D Sugar Cane, 3D Bushes, 3D Lily Pads, 3D Fungi, 3D Vines, 3D Glow Lichen
  - 3D Stonecutters
  - 3D Sun & Moon
  - 3D Sculk Vains
  - 3D Redstone Wire
  - 3D Items
  - 3D Doors & Trapdoors
  - 3D Amethyst Crystals
- *Aesthetic*
  - Flint Tipped Arrows
  - Colorful Enchanting Table Particles
  - Splash Bottle o' Enchanting
- *Unobstrusive*
  - Lower Fire
  - Lower Shield
- *Utility*
  - Visual Cauldron, Composter, Honey Stages
  - Visual NoteBlock Pitch
  - Brewing Guide
  - Directional Hoppers, Dispensers, Droppers, Observers
  - Groovy Levers
  - Redstone Power Levels
  - Fully Aged Crop & Amethyst Cluster Marker
  
### Convenience (Data Packs)
- Cauldron Concrete & Mud
